hints.title: What survives normalization?
hints.body: Discard everything except letters and digits, and compare letters without case.

hints.title: Two ends move inward
hints.body: Place one pointer at each end. Skip ignored characters, then compare the remaining characters.

hints.title: Stop conditions
hints.body: If the pointers meet or cross, every pair matched. A mismatch stops the scan immediately.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
left = 0, right = length - 1
while left < right:
    skip non-alphanumeric from left and right
    if left < right and lower(text[left]) != lower(text[right]): return false
    left += 1; right -= 1
return true
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
